    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

                    # Continue the diagonal pair from its second endpoint.
                    rays.add((color, r2 + dr, c2 + dc, dr, dc))
    # Most frequent color is the background; each ray paints only empty cells.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    for color, r, c, dr, dc in rays:
        while 0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and out[r][c] == bg:
            out[r][c] = color
            r += dr
            c += dc
    return out
